[Building for Stability After Natural Disasters][147]

rebuilding and how CNA can help.

brand dedicated to serving the wholesale market.^{ }

[Tornado touching down]

[Discover the Hidden Risks to your Property][152]

[Group of 3 looking at computer | CNA Insurance]

#### CAREERS AT CNA

# How can we help you today?

Powerful business insurance solutions, tailored to meet your needs.

[ Find an Agent ][145] [ File a Claim ][146]
[Construction workers on site | CNA Insurance]

#### REBUILDING RESILIENT COMMUNITIES

[Building for Stability After Natural Disasters][147]

Construction companies are on the front lines after natural disasters. Learn about the challenges of
rebuilding and how CNA can help.

[Aerial view of a lake alongside a road and forest]

#### EXCESS AND SURPLUS

[Cardinal E&S^{SM} - A CNA Brand][148]

CNA is furthering its dedication to the excess and surplus market by establishing Cardinal E&S, a
brand dedicated to serving the wholesale market.^{ }

[west-coast-wildfire-smoke]

#### RISK CONTROL

[Wildfire Preparedness][149]

Learn more about how businesses and individuals can better prepare for wildfires.

[Construction workers working on site]

#### CONSTRUCTION SAFETY INSIGHTS

[Safety Insights and Claims Trends][150]

Explore real-world claims insights and industry-leading risk control resources to manage
construction risk and protect workers.

[Colleagues walking and talking outside]

#### CNA'S FINANCIAL STRENGTH RECOGNIZED

[CNA Achieves A+ (Superior) Rating from AM Best][151]

We are proud to share that AM Best has upgraded CNA’s financial strength rating to A+ (Superior).

[Tornado touching down]

#### SEVERE CONVECTIVE STORMS

[Discover the Hidden Risks to your Property][152]

Learn how severe convective storms are becoming more common and damaging. Stay prepared with our
latest insights from Dan Ehrhardt, CNA's National Accounts Property leader.

[Group of 3 looking at computer | CNA Insurance]

#### CAREERS AT CNA

[Discover a Rewarding Career at CNA][153]

Whether you’re experienced or just embarking on your career, learn about CNA and how we pursue
common goals together.

[Two colleagues going over paperwork in an office]

#### MISC. PROFESSIONAL LIABILITY

[Tailored, Reliable Coverage][154]

Learn more about CNA's Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL) coverage.

liability, collision and comprehensive coverage. That gives you insurance for damage and injuries
you cause others (liability), and damage to your own car and theft (collision and comprehensive).

## How much will auto insurance cost?

The average premium paid for full coverage is about $138 a month, based on premiums reported by
EverQuote users. That's based on good drivers with the "typical" level of coverage shown above.

Of course you can spend less by buying less coverage, but you might regret it later if you're in an
accident.

## How car insurance quotes are calculated

Rates can vary quite a bit when you compare car insurance because insurance companies all have their
own way of calculating prices. Still, here are factors generally used in auto insurance quotes:

**The drivers.** Age and driving experience affect quotes. So do moving violations such as speeding
tickets. This includes all the licensed drivers in your household.

**Past claims and accidents.** Having caused accidents and made claims will usually mean higher
rates.

**How the vehicle is used and where it's parked. ** Do you use the vehicle for personal or business
reasons? Where is it parked at night? These typically affect car insurance quotes.

**Credit.** Poor credit can mean higher auto insurance rates. The insurance industry correlates poor
credit to a higher chance that a driver will make a claim. This practice is banned in California,
Hawaii and Massachusetts.

**The vehicle.** Insurers often use data on past claims on a vehicle like yours to calculate car
insurance quotes. If other drivers of your model have made a lot of claims, or the vehicle is
expensive to repair, that can be reflected in a car insurance quote.

## Three steps to insure your business

View video transcript.
**I. Leadership roundtable discussion introduction**

**JENNY RUNDE, SENIOR VP PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT:** Insureon is the largest provider of small business
insurance online. We make it easy for small business owners to come to our site and find coverage
for their businesses. They can come to our website, fill out a single application, and get quotes
back in seconds from all of the top carriers. And at that point, they're in the hands of our our
insurance agents who can walk them through all their questions, all of their concerns and make sure
that they've got the coverage that they need.

**II. How do our experts ensure you get what you need?**

**KARI ALLEN, VP SALES:** We have best-in-class sales producers who are dedicated to small market.
They specialize in the micro businesses and focus completely on what are the needs of the small
business client, what questions might they have, and where to direct them to help them understand
coverages. We found that over 90% of small business customers don't understand the coverage
insurance that they need, so their job is to help them understand what they need, and how to get
that coverage in place. And so they walk them through as their trusted advisor.

**III. What do we deliver long-term for small business owners?**

**DY KUNKEL, VP ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT:** After the producers write the coverage for the clients, then
it transfers over to our account management team, which our account management team's goal is to
provide ease to the customers and retain their business. Our customers are really busy as business
owners trying to run their small business, so it's our job to make their lives easier and provide
them with that comfort and support of giving them the insurance that they need for their business.

**IV. What added value comes along with that?**

**JENNIFER CROMLY, DIRECTOR SALES, OPERATIONS, ANALYTICS:** We provide value because we are an
insurance agency that works with small business owners all over the country. And in doing so, we
provide the business owner the autonomy to be able to provide us their information on their
timetable.

We have such strong relationships with all of our carriers and our experienced producers so that
wherever that small business owner is located, we have a carrier that is going to provide the most
competitive coverage and the most comprehensive coverage, and we're then going to be able to
maintain this relationship with the small business owner throughout their growth and changes as they
also develop as a small business owner. I think as a small business owner there is so much
responsibility that they have, and protecting their business from loss is one of the largest
exposures that they have, and it's our privilege to be able to work with them.

**V. What insurance companies can you choose from?**

**MAURA BENSON, DIRECTOR CARRIER RELATIONSHIPS:** We partner with A+ rated carriers in order to
accommodate many different types of small business owners and and what they're doing. Anything from
lawn care and accounting, to restaurants and IT Consultants. By establishing these strong
relationships, we're able to provide competitive rates as well as have a good understanding of the
service center capabilities and just being able to give our clients the the best options available
in the market.

**VI. How do small business owners find us?**

**YULIA KRONROD, SENIOR VP CUSTOMER ACQUISITION:** Most customers find us through Google, but the
way they search for information varies greatly. Some people search for their profession and how they
can protect their type of business with insurance, others search for policy type. Yet, others just
simply ask a question "Do I need insurance at all?" or "How do I renew my policy?" and things like
that, so we try to educate customers on all those types of queries that they ask in Google or other
search engines. We have information around what type of policies you need if you run this type of
business, what a specific type of policy covers, we have educational articles for them on how to
start and develop their business into something viable that they can succeed with, and things like
that.

**VII. What are we doing to make it easy for small business owners to buy insurance?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** We know that many of our customers are a brand new business or new to buying
business insurance, and so it can be a really stressful decision to make and one of the first things
we try to do on our site is really educate people. Give them all the articles and the blogs and the
information that's going to help educate them and inform them on what they need and what their
options are. We also have the ability through technology to actually recommend products to them so
have them answer a few simple questions about their business, and in seconds basically can recommend
the types of insurance that they might need to cover their businesses.

So once they're at a point where they feel fairly comfortable with the types of insurance that they
might need, and they've got some of those questions answered, then it's really our goal to make that
process as seamless as possible in filling out the application. So from there they can select their
profession type, they fill out a simple application online, and in the seconds they're able to get
prices that are real time prices with all of the best carriers.

**KARI ALLEN:** By the time the application comes in and they compare coverages and they've either
selected to go with certain carrier it's our producer's job to take a look at everything they put
in, make sure that that makes sense, and then reach out to the customer and interact with them the
way they want to be interacted with, whether that's text, whether that's phone, or whether that's
email. And what they do is really review the coverages that they put together and you say "Does this
make sense? What state is it in? Are our producers are licensed in every state? What carrier's
actions do they have? Have they chosen a carrier that makes sense for their needs?"

And I think, to put a bow on it, obviously in insurance and potential insurance, that small business
customers are going to have questions, and we can interact with these customers again how they want
to be interacted with, but they're going to have questions about "What is covered? What isn't
covered? How do I file a claim? What are some things that I need to be aware of as I'm issuing the
policies?" And that's what our people are there for that to make sure that we put the customer and
small business customers needs first and make sure that they are covered and, you know, set their
mind at ease.

**DY KUNKEL:** After our clients have selected coverage through Kari's team, then they have the
ability to go on and review that coverage again on our customer portal. Our customer portal also
offers them the ability to look back at policies they've had previously, make changes to their
current policies, request endorsements if they need to on that coverage. They can also get a
certificate of insurance that shows proof of their coverage that they do have today. They can review
which carriers they're with, as well, and the pricing of the coverage they have currently. And they
can also find their insurance agent to get in contact with them, all by using our customer portal.

**VIII. Where and when are we talking to customers?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** Small business owners are...they're busy people. They're not always in front of
their desk, right? They're growing their businesses, they're working with customers, they're out in
the field. And so we know as an organization that we have to meet them where they are. And we have
to be available when they are. And so for us, we really think very often about mobile as a key
channel for our customers. So many of our customers come to us via their mobile devices, right? They
could be could be late at night after leaving a job site, and that's the only time that they have to
be able to search for insurance, and so that's where we really focus on our website of being
optimized for that mobile experience so that it is as easy for them to buy insurance via their
mobile device or their desktop as it would be walking into a brick and mortar.

## Three steps to insure your business

View video transcript.
**I. Leadership roundtable discussion introduction**

**JENNY RUNDE, SENIOR VP PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT:** Insureon is the largest provider of small business
insurance online. We make it easy for small business owners to come to our site and find coverage
for their businesses. They can come to our website, fill out a single application, and get quotes
back in seconds from all of the top carriers. And at that point, they're in the hands of our our
insurance agents who can walk them through all their questions, all of their concerns and make sure
that they've got the coverage that they need.

**II. How do our experts ensure you get what you need?**

**KARI ALLEN, VP SALES:** We have best-in-class sales producers who are dedicated to small market.
They specialize in the micro businesses and focus completely on what are the needs of the small
business client, what questions might they have, and where to direct them to help them understand
coverages. We found that over 90% of small business customers don't understand the coverage
insurance that they need, so their job is to help them understand what they need, and how to get
that coverage in place. And so they walk them through as their trusted advisor.

**III. What do we deliver long-term for small business owners?**

**DY KUNKEL, VP ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT:** After the producers write the coverage for the clients, then
it transfers over to our account management team, which our account management team's goal is to
provide ease to the customers and retain their business. Our customers are really busy as business
owners trying to run their small business, so it's our job to make their lives easier and provide
them with that comfort and support of giving them the insurance that they need for their business.

**IV. What added value comes along with that?**

**JENNIFER CROMLY, DIRECTOR SALES, OPERATIONS, ANALYTICS:** We provide value because we are an
insurance agency that works with small business owners all over the country. And in doing so, we
provide the business owner the autonomy to be able to provide us their information on their
timetable.

We have such strong relationships with all of our carriers and our experienced producers so that
wherever that small business owner is located, we have a carrier that is going to provide the most
competitive coverage and the most comprehensive coverage, and we're then going to be able to
maintain this relationship with the small business owner throughout their growth and changes as they
also develop as a small business owner. I think as a small business owner there is so much
responsibility that they have, and protecting their business from loss is one of the largest
exposures that they have, and it's our privilege to be able to work with them.

**V. What insurance companies can you choose from?**

**MAURA BENSON, DIRECTOR CARRIER RELATIONSHIPS:** We partner with A+ rated carriers in order to
accommodate many different types of small business owners and and what they're doing. Anything from
lawn care and accounting, to restaurants and IT Consultants. By establishing these strong
relationships, we're able to provide competitive rates as well as have a good understanding of the
service center capabilities and just being able to give our clients the the best options available
in the market.

**VI. How do small business owners find us?**

**YULIA KRONROD, SENIOR VP CUSTOMER ACQUISITION:** Most customers find us through Google, but the
way they search for information varies greatly. Some people search for their profession and how they
can protect their type of business with insurance, others search for policy type. Yet, others just
simply ask a question "Do I need insurance at all?" or "How do I renew my policy?" and things like
that, so we try to educate customers on all those types of queries that they ask in Google or other
search engines. We have information around what type of policies you need if you run this type of
business, what a specific type of policy covers, we have educational articles for them on how to
start and develop their business into something viable that they can succeed with, and things like
that.

**VII. What are we doing to make it easy for small business owners to buy insurance?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** We know that many of our customers are a brand new business or new to buying
business insurance, and so it can be a really stressful decision to make and one of the first things
we try to do on our site is really educate people. Give them all the articles and the blogs and the
information that's going to help educate them and inform them on what they need and what their
options are. We also have the ability through technology to actually recommend products to them so
have them answer a few simple questions about their business, and in seconds basically can recommend
the types of insurance that they might need to cover their businesses.

So once they're at a point where they feel fairly comfortable with the types of insurance that they
might need, and they've got some of those questions answered, then it's really our goal to make that
process as seamless as possible in filling out the application. So from there they can select their
profession type, they fill out a simple application online, and in the seconds they're able to get
prices that are real time prices with all of the best carriers.

**KARI ALLEN:** By the time the application comes in and they compare coverages and they've either
selected to go with certain carrier it's our producer's job to take a look at everything they put
in, make sure that that makes sense, and then reach out to the customer and interact with them the
way they want to be interacted with, whether that's text, whether that's phone, or whether that's
email. And what they do is really review the coverages that they put together and you say "Does this
make sense? What state is it in? Are our producers are licensed in every state? What carrier's
actions do they have? Have they chosen a carrier that makes sense for their needs?"

And I think, to put a bow on it, obviously in insurance and potential insurance, that small business
customers are going to have questions, and we can interact with these customers again how they want
to be interacted with, but they're going to have questions about "What is covered? What isn't
covered? How do I file a claim? What are some things that I need to be aware of as I'm issuing the
policies?" And that's what our people are there for that to make sure that we put the customer and
small business customers needs first and make sure that they are covered and, you know, set their
mind at ease.

**DY KUNKEL:** After our clients have selected coverage through Kari's team, then they have the
ability to go on and review that coverage again on our customer portal. Our customer portal also
offers them the ability to look back at policies they've had previously, make changes to their
current policies, request endorsements if they need to on that coverage. They can also get a
certificate of insurance that shows proof of their coverage that they do have today. They can review
which carriers they're with, as well, and the pricing of the coverage they have currently. And they
can also find their insurance agent to get in contact with them, all by using our customer portal.

**VIII. Where and when are we talking to customers?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** Small business owners are...they're busy people. They're not always in front of
their desk, right? They're growing their businesses, they're working with customers, they're out in
the field. And so we know as an organization that we have to meet them where they are. And we have
to be available when they are. And so for us, we really think very often about mobile as a key
channel for our customers. So many of our customers come to us via their mobile devices, right? They
could be could be late at night after leaving a job site, and that's the only time that they have to
be able to search for insurance, and so that's where we really focus on our website of being
optimized for that mobile experience so that it is as easy for them to buy insurance via their
mobile device or their desktop as it would be walking into a brick and mortar.

## Protecting what's most important

We’ve grown from a small mutual auto insurance company, owned by policyholders who spent their days
farming in Ohio, to one of the largest insurance and financial services companies in the world.

Today we still answer to our members, but we protect more than just cars and Ohio farmers. We’re a
Fortune 100 company that offers a full range of insurance and financial services across the country.
Including car, motorcycle, homeowners, pet, farm, life and commercial insurance. As well as
annuities, mutual funds, retirement plans and specialty health services.

**We’ve served generations. Protecting what’s most important. Let us do the same for you.**

# Insurance and Benefits

International health insurance for Individuals and Employers.
Find the right plan for you below:

## **International Health Insurance for you and your family**

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.
[ INTERNATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE (12+ MONTHS) ][106]
[ SHORT TERM HEALTH INSURANCE (3-9 MONTHS) ][107]
[Young women smiling at camera]

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.
[ GET A QUOTE ][108]

You have access to a range of services gathered in one convenient hub to help protect you and your
family from preventable health risks. Our services include Telehealth Hub, Expat Assistance
programme, Fitness coaching App, Nutrition Hub, Travel Security and more.

### Travel delays leave you stranded.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for eligible meals, accommodation and transportation expenses
during a covered delay.

### You get sick or hurt when you're far from home.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for care following a covered medical emergency while traveling.
We can even arrange and pay for a medical evacuation if needed.

### Fender-benders are unavoidable.

Renting a car means taking on a big financial risk; even a tiny scrape can cost you hundreds.
Low-priced rental car insurance lets you drive worry-free.

### You need help in a hurry.

Whether you're planning a week-long road trip or a weekend getaway, you never know what might
happen. Travel insurance gives you access to our 24-Hour Assistance hotline for expert, personalized
support in a crisis.

# AncillaryOne – Unified API for Travel Ancillary Services

Integrate once, sell everything. AncillaryOne connects airlines, OTAs, and travel platforms to
eSIMs, lounges, refund protection, transfers, and more through a single API.

## Ancillary Services
* [eSIM Data Plans][1] – Global connectivity in 190+ countries
* [Refund Protection][2] – Turn non-refundable bookings into flexible options
* [Flight Tracking][3] – Real-time flight status with notifications
* [Carbon Offsetting][4] – Verified environmental offset projects
* [Private Transfers][5] – Airport and ground transportation
* [Tours & Activities][6] – Destination experiences and excursions
* [Lounge Access][7] – Airport lounge bookings worldwide
* [Flight Delay Compensation][8] – EU261 claims processing
* [Baggage Compensation][9] – Lost and delayed baggage claims

## Resources
* [Ancillary Revenue Calculator][10] – Estimate ancillary revenue uplift for travel sellers based on
  booking volume, attach rates, and margins. Ancillary revenue accounts for nearly 15% of airline
  income globally ($148B+).
* [Flight API Leaderboard][11] – Ranked comparison of major flight API providers (GDS, Aggregators,
  Metasearch) scored on coverage, NDC readiness, developer experience, ancillary depth, and market
  presence.
* [Hotel API Leaderboard][12] – Ranked comparison of major hotel API providers (Direct, Bedbank,
  Aggregator) including Booking.com, Expedia, Hotelbeds, Ratehawk, and more.
* [Monetisation Guide][13] – Comprehensive guide on how to make money selling travel ancillaries,
  covering business models, channels, tech stack, and unit economics.

## Thought Leadership
* [How MCP Servers Are Shaping Travel][14] – How Model Context Protocol is reshaping travel
  technology and AI accessibility.
* [NDC Players Shaping Airline Distribution][15] – Analysis of NDC implementation challenges and key
  players.
* [How Online Travel Agencies Make Money][16] – Revenue models and the future of OTAs in an AI-first
  world.

## Our insurance complies with European requirements

Before submitting a [Schengen visa][87] application, the European Union requires each applicant to
take out specific travel insurance, covering emergency medical expenses and repatriation during the
stay. This mandatory insurance must meet strict criteria, defined in Article 15 of the [EU visa][88]
regulations:
* Cover emergency medical expenses, hospitalization, as well as repatriation in case of illness or
  death, with a minimum of €30,000
* Be valid in all Schengen area countries
* Be valid for the entire duration of the stay
* Be accepted by all consular services of all member states issuing Schengen visas

Important! The certificate of this [Schengen health insurance][89] is part of the [mandatory
documents][90] to include with your application file. Without this travel insurance certificate,
your visa application will be refused.

**Our AXA Schengen travel insurance policies are all compliant for obtaining a Schengen VISA. We
provide you with a certificate that can be downloaded immediately after purchase confirmation.**

You can leave with peace of mind and focus on what matters most, knowing that, if necessary, your

## Frequently asked questions

### Does AXA also deal with the processing of visa applications at embassies?

AXA Schengen does not process visa applications. We provide the travel insurance document that is
one of the requirements for your Schengen visa application. For the actual visa application process,
you'll need to contact the embassy or consulate of the Schengen country you plan to visit. For
helpful visa application information, you can visit our [guide to get a visa][95].

### Will I receive the policy document for visa approval immediately after purchasing?

Yes, you will receive your insurance certificate immediately after your payment is processed. The
document will be sent to your email and will also be available to download on the confirmation page
of your purchase. This certificate contains all the information required by embassies for visa
applications, including coverage amounts, policy dates, and emergency contact information. Please
check your spam/junk folder if you don't see it in your inbox within a few minutes of purchase.

### What specific information does the embassy need to see on the insurance certificate?

Our insurance certificates display all information prominently, making them easily acceptable by all
Schengen embassies. We format our certificates specifically to highlight these key requirements for
visa officials.

Schengen embassies require your insurance certificate to clearly show:
* Your full name and birth date matching your passport
* Coverage for the entire duration of your planned stay
* Minimum coverage amount of €30,000 for medical expenses
* Coverage for emergency medical treatment
* Coverage for medical repatriation
* Validity throughout all Schengen countries

### Do your insurances cover all countries in the Schengen area?

Yes, our Schengen insurances covers all Schengen area countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria,
Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland,
Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal,
Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland.

The coverage is valid throughout the entire Schengen area during your stay, regardless of which
specific Schengen countries you plan to visit. The insurance meets the requirements for visa
applications to any Schengen country.

### Can I get a refund if my visa is refused?

Yes, we offer a full refund if your visa application is refused. Here's the simple process:
1. Email us at info.schengen@axa-schengen.com with the following information:
   * First name
   * Last name
   * Policy number
   * Date of purchase
   * Visa review date
   * Additional comments
2. Attach a copy of the official visa refusal letter from the embassy/consulate. The document must
   contain the name of the insured as well as a date and stamp from the embassy.
3. We'll process your refund within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

Additionally, with our Essential and Annual plans, you are also covered in the UK, Ireland, and
Cyprus. Please note that our Basic plan only covers the Schengen area.

## Our insurance complies with European requirements

Before submitting a [Schengen visa][87] application, the European Union requires each applicant to
take out specific travel insurance, covering emergency medical expenses and repatriation during the
stay. This mandatory insurance must meet strict criteria, defined in Article 15 of the [EU visa][88]
regulations:
* Cover emergency medical expenses, hospitalization, as well as repatriation in case of illness or
  death, with a minimum of €30,000
* Be valid in all Schengen area countries
* Be valid for the entire duration of the stay
* Be accepted by all consular services of all member states issuing Schengen visas

Important! The certificate of this [Schengen health insurance][89] is part of the [mandatory
documents][90] to include with your application file. Without this travel insurance certificate,
your visa application will be refused.

provide you with a certificate that can be downloaded immediately after purchase confirmation.**

## Frequently asked questions

### Does AXA also deal with the processing of visa applications at embassies?

AXA Schengen does not process visa applications. We provide the travel insurance document that is
one of the requirements for your Schengen visa application. For the actual visa application process,
you'll need to contact the embassy or consulate of the Schengen country you plan to visit. For
helpful visa application information, you can visit our [guide to get a visa][95].

### Will I receive the policy document for visa approval immediately after purchasing?

Yes, you will receive your insurance certificate immediately after your payment is processed. The
document will be sent to your email and will also be available to download on the confirmation page
of your purchase. This certificate contains all the information required by embassies for visa
applications, including coverage amounts, policy dates, and emergency contact information. Please
check your spam/junk folder if you don't see it in your inbox within a few minutes of purchase.

### What specific information does the embassy need to see on the insurance certificate?

Our insurance certificates display all information prominently, making them easily acceptable by all
Schengen embassies. We format our certificates specifically to highlight these key requirements for
visa officials.

Schengen embassies require your insurance certificate to clearly show:
* Your full name and birth date matching your passport
* Coverage for the entire duration of your planned stay
* Minimum coverage amount of €30,000 for medical expenses
* Coverage for emergency medical treatment
* Coverage for medical repatriation
* Validity throughout all Schengen countries

### Do your insurances cover all countries in the Schengen area?

Yes, our Schengen insurances covers all Schengen area countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria,
Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland,
Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal,
Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland.

The coverage is valid throughout the entire Schengen area during your stay, regardless of which
specific Schengen countries you plan to visit. The insurance meets the requirements for visa
applications to any Schengen country.

### Can I get a refund if my visa is refused?

Yes, we offer a full refund if your visa application is refused. Here's the simple process:
1. Email us at info.schengen@axa-schengen.com with the following information:
   * First name
   * Last name
   * Policy number
   * Date of purchase
   * Visa review date
   * Additional comments
2. Attach a copy of the official visa refusal letter from the embassy/consulate. The document must
   contain the name of the insured as well as a date and stamp from the embassy.
3. We'll process your refund within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

Additionally, with our Essential and Annual plans, you are also covered in the UK, Ireland, and
Cyprus. Please note that our Basic plan only covers the Schengen area.

## Frequently asked questions

## What does Marsh do?

Marsh helps organizations navigate risk, develop their people, build their strategies to help them
thrive. With more than 95,000 colleagues in over 130 countries, we deliver expertise across risk,
reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting.

## What industries does Marsh serve?

We serve clients across a wide range of industries, including financial services, healthcare,
energy, manufacturing, construction, technology, retail, transportation, and the public sector.

## How is Marsh different from other professional services firms?

We bring together distinct capabilities across risk, strategy, and people. This means we can connect
data, insights, and solutions from across our firm to address our clients’ most complex challenges
and opportunities.

## I already work with one of your businesses. Can I access services from your other businesses?

Yes. Many of our clients work with multiple Marsh businesses to address interconnected challenges.
Your current team can introduce you to colleagues across Marsh.

## Is Marsh the same as Marsh McLennan?

Marsh McLennan changed its brand to Marsh effective January 2026. Marsh, our insurance broker, is
now known as Marsh Risk. Our other businesses will adopt the Marsh brand following a transition
period. This is a change to our brand strategy, not our business structure. We will continue to
serve clients as we do today across risk, strategy, and people.

## Is the stock ticker symbol changing?

Yes. Our stock ticker symbol changed from MMC to MRSH on the New York Stock Exchange in January
2026. [Learn more.][16]

## What does Marsh do?

Marsh helps organizations navigate risk, develop their people, build their strategies to help them
thrive. With more than 95,000 colleagues in over 130 countries, we deliver expertise across risk,
reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting.

## What industries does Marsh serve?

We serve clients across a wide range of industries, including financial services, healthcare,
energy, manufacturing, construction, technology, retail, transportation, and the public sector.

## How is Marsh different from other professional services firms?

We bring together distinct capabilities across risk, strategy, and people. This means we can connect
data, insights, and solutions from across our firm to address our clients’ most complex challenges
and opportunities.

## I already work with one of your businesses. Can I access services from your other businesses?

Yes. Many of our clients work with multiple Marsh businesses to address interconnected challenges.
Your current team can introduce you to colleagues across Marsh.

Marsh McLennan changed its brand to Marsh effective January 2026. Marsh, our insurance broker, is
now known as Marsh Risk. Our other businesses will adopt the Marsh brand following a transition
period. This is a change to our brand strategy, not our business structure. We will continue to
serve clients as we do today across risk, strategy, and people.

# Mapa rizik EGAP

Barometr EGAP hodnotící rizikovost zemí vychází z komplexního interního hodnocení politické,
ekonomické a finanční situace země a může se lišit od oficiální kategorizace OECD. Zohledňuje nejen
suverénní riziko země, ale také platební zkušenosti EGAP a partnerských ECAs, rizika plynoucí ze
struktury ekonomiky, politické situace, právního, bezpečnostního a podnikatelského prostředí,
bankovního sektoru a další.

Suverénní riziko je riziko ministerstva financí (platební schopnost a vůle ze strany státu). ECAs
jsou exportní agentury jako EGAP v zemích OECD.

Temporary coverage to protect you during life’s transition periods

# A Temporary Health Insurance Plan Is Easy To Obtain And Provides Coverage You Can Afford.

Don’t wait! Make an affordable choice and protect your health with Flex Term short-term medical
insurance.

[START HERE][6]

# What Is Short-Term Health Insurance Used For?

Short-term health insurance is your *lifeline* during gaps in coverage—whether you’re between jobs,
transitioning off a parent’s plan, or waiting for open enrollment. The Flex Term Health Insurance
Plan offers you fast, flexible protection when you need it most.

With premiums designed to be budget-friendly, these plans deliver essential medical coverage without
breaking the bank.

Coverage can start as soon as tomorrow and you can cancel anytime without penalties. 

## Who Uses Temporary Health Insurance?
* Individuals who missed the deadlines for the ACA exchanges and need to wait until the next
  enrollment period
* Individuals who have a waiting period before enrollment in another program
* People who need health insurance in between jobs or have been laid off
* [People looking for a less expensive COBRA health insurance alternative][7]
* Those needing temporary coverage:
  * College students or recent graduates
  * Young adults coming off their parent’s health benefit plan
  * Retirees waiting for Medicare eligibility
  * Coverage for dependents not covered under an employer plan

#### Quick Coverage, Flexible Plans

Find short-term health insurance plans for less. Keep yourself safe with temporary health coverage.

[See Plans][8]
[Person looking at plans on a laptop][Person looking at plans on a laptop]

### Flex Term Health Insurance Plan Options²
* Deductible options ($1,000, $2,500, $5,000, $7,500, or $10,000)
* Co-pay : $50
* Co-insurance options (50/50, 70/30, 80/20, or 100/0)
* Coverage period maximum ($250,000, $750,000, $1,000,000, or $1,500,000)
* Length of coverage options
* Eligibility 18-64 years old (child only coverage for ages 2-25)
* Monthly or pre-pay payment options
* Free-look period

[Start Here][9]

Office Visit Copays Are $50

FlexTerm short-term health insurance is currently available in:
AL, AZ, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MS, MO, NE, NV, NC, OH, OK, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WV, WI, and
WY

## How Does Flex Term Temporary Health Insurance Work?

FIRST

 

$50 copay for physician office visit
$50 copay for annual wellness exam

THEN

 

Cover your deductible of $1000, $2500, $5000, $7500 or $10,000
Your deductible is the amount you must pay before FlexTerm Health Insurance pays benefits.

Coinsurance Options:
* 50%/50% – You pay 50% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 70%/30% – You pay 30% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 80%/20% – You pay 20% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 100% – We pay 100% of the covered charges up to the plan maximum

AFTER

**FlexTerm Health pays all remaining covered charges, up to the Policy Period Maximum.**

## Flex Term Health Insurance Highlights
* Plans available up to 12 months*
* 5 minute simple applaication process
* Flexibility to choose your own physician and hospitals
* Next Day Coverage

* Some states may vary

## Summary of Coverages
* Wellness
* Inpatient/Outpatient Surgery
* Hospital Benefits
* Emergency Room Care
* Outpatient Services
* X-Ray and Laboratory
* Transplant Benefits
* Urgent Care
* Sickness

### About The Carrier

[Everest Reinsurance Company Logo 2022][Everest Reinsurance Company Logo 2022]

Everest Re Group Ltd. is a holding company that provides reinsurance and insurance services.  The
U.S. Reinsurance segment writes property and liability reinsurance as well as specialist lines of
business such as marine, aviation, surety, and accident and health through reinsurance brokers as

# Health Insurance for Digital Nomads

Every country. Any doctor or hospital. We've got you covered.

[Get covered][7][Travelers love us[Rating]on[Trustpilot]][8]

## Explore the world

No need to tell us where you're going. Just go. We've got you covered.

We cover necessary medical treatment. 24/7 emergency assistance hotline.

## Choose any doctor

We cover treatment at every licensed healthcare provider worldwide.

## We make it easy

Get an instant price and sign up online, even if you're already abroad.

[Get covered][9]

* Scooter crash in Thailand
* Dengue fever in Bali
* Ear infection in Vietnam
* Surfing accident in South Africa
* Broken foot in Spain
* COVID-19 in Colombia

4. Get well soon

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

#### Golden

# The home for 
# non-standard insurance

[Find out more][43]
[Make a claim][44]

Haven provides short term and annual insurance policies to suit a wide range of non-standard needs.
We specialise in helping clients find cover when they have struggled to obtain insurance elsewhere.

#### Insures over 500,000 policyholders

#### Solvency Cover Ratio in excess of 170%

#### Short term and annual cover

#### Over £550m+ paid out in claims last year

What we do

## As a specialist in non-standard insurance, Haven has built a reputation on developing products
## outside of the mainstream motor and household markets.

As well as dedicated products for private household and motor, we also offer public and private hire
insurance, fleet, motor trade, minibus and commercial vehicle insurance. In addition to the
traditional annual insurance policy, we offer temporary motor insurance covering a number of
different requirements.

Haven products are available throughout the UK, both online and via the offices of our partners
including [Acorn Insurance & Financial Services Ltd][45], [Carrot][46], [Motorcade][47], [Flag][48],
[Rapid][49], [Street Cover][50] and [Briefly][51].

### Haven is constantly evolving, expanding, and developing new products.

Haven is a proud member of the Acorn Group, one of the UK’s largest non-standard motor insurance
companies.

* What's the difference between travel insurance and cancellation insurance?
  Travel insurance covers your entire trip (medical expenses, repatriation, baggage, etc.), while
  cancellation insurance only covers costs if you cancel before departure. Both can be taken out
  separately or together.
* Is my bank card insurance enough?
  Bank card insurance generally offers basic protection with low limits (usually €30,000 to €150,000

## Visiting Ukraine in 2026: Entry Rules, Border Access & Insurance Tips

Planning a trip to Ukraine in 2026? Despite martial law, entry is allowed and safe through land
borders. Here's what you need to know:

#### Entry Requirements for Foreign Visitors

You can legally enter Ukraine if you:
* Have a valid passport (must be valid for your entire stay; citizens of Turkey and Georgia can
  enter with a national ID card);
* Hold a health insurance policy (mandatory for most travelers, especially media and public figures
  — as required by Ukrainian law);
* Have a visa (unless your country has a visa-free agreement with Ukraine);
* Can prove the purpose of your visit (e.g. tourism, business, volunteering);
* Can show sufficient financial means for your stay and return;
* Are not subject to an entry ban by Ukrainian authorities.

Note: Ukrainian residence permits that expired after February 24, 2022 remain valid during martial
law and for 30 days after its end (this does not apply to citizens of the Russian Federation).

#### Visa & Border Information for 2026

Citizens of many countries (including the EU, UK, US, and Canada) can enter Ukraine visa-free for up
to 90 days within a 180-day period. Others will need to obtain a visa through a consulate or the
e-visa system. You can check your visa status on the Insurance Ukraine website by selecting your
nationality. Ukraine's borders remain open with Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova.
Border crossings with Russia, Belarus, and Transnistria are closed. Always check updated border
crossing hours, queues, and lists of prohibited items before traveling.

#### Health Insurance Advice for Ukraine

Travelers are strongly advised to purchase medical insurance with war risk coverage for the entire
duration of their stay. This type of policy typically covers:
* Emergency medical care
* Outpatient treatment and hospitalization
* War-related injuries and passive war risks
* Repatriation (in case of injury or death)

## Visiting Ukraine in 2026: Entry Rules, Border Access & Insurance Tips

Planning a trip to Ukraine in 2026? Despite martial law, entry is allowed and safe through land
borders. Here's what you need to know:

#### Entry Requirements for Foreign Visitors

You can legally enter Ukraine if you:
* Have a valid passport (must be valid for your entire stay; citizens of Turkey and Georgia can
  enter with a national ID card);
* Hold a health insurance policy (mandatory for most travelers, especially media and public figures
  — as required by Ukrainian law);
* Have a visa (unless your country has a visa-free agreement with Ukraine);
* Can prove the purpose of your visit (e.g. tourism, business, volunteering);
* Can show sufficient financial means for your stay and return;
* Are not subject to an entry ban by Ukrainian authorities.

Note: Ukrainian residence permits that expired after February 24, 2022 remain valid during martial
law and for 30 days after its end (this does not apply to citizens of the Russian Federation).

#### Visa & Border Information for 2026

Citizens of many countries (including the EU, UK, US, and Canada) can enter Ukraine visa-free for up
to 90 days within a 180-day period. Others will need to obtain a visa through a consulate or the
e-visa system. You can check your visa status on the Insurance Ukraine website by selecting your
nationality. Ukraine's borders remain open with Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova.
Border crossings with Russia, Belarus, and Transnistria are closed. Always check updated border
crossing hours, queues, and lists of prohibited items before traveling.

#### Health Insurance Advice for Ukraine

Travelers are strongly advised to purchase medical insurance with war risk coverage for the entire
duration of their stay. This type of policy typically covers:
* Emergency medical care
* Outpatient treatment and hospitalization
* War-related injuries and passive war risks
* Repatriation (in case of injury or death)

# We're experts

You have come to the correct web site if you are seeking a dedicated licensed agent and broker.
Athena Insurance and Financial Services has been servicing insured's needs since 1996 with
everything from life insurance to loggers broad form insurance.  Experience matters!

##### **Loggers Broad form third party fire suppression liability****
##### **

We offer Loggers Broad Form Liabilitin on a stand-alone basis. Please understand, you are required
to “have” General Liability to obtain Loggers Broad Form. 

We can provide you with both Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. But, if you already have
General Liability we will “consider” writing the Loggers Broad Form for your. 

The concern for us is that your General Liability coveres the classes of opertaions related to why
you are needing the loggers broad form. 

We highly recommend having us write both the Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. 

[ Quote Logger Broad Form Now][26]

##### **Inland Marine & logging equipment & misc. tools
##### **

Inland Marine Insurance is available on a “stand-alone” basis for qualified prospects and clients.  

Eligibility will depend on a number of factors such as proof of prior coverage, claim experience
history, number of pieces of equipment, geographic and more. 

What do we need to quote? We need an Inland Marine intake form. You may submit one at your leisure
of call us and we will complete one for you. 

We must have the following: Year Make, model, serial number, current market value and loss payee
name & address.



[ Quote Inland Marine Coverage][27]

##### **Commercial Auto & Transportation
##### **

Single vehicles to fleets. Heavy duty trucks to log haulers we provide services to nearly all States
in the U.S. 

Options may include “Excess” liability, non-owne auto, drive – other car, hire auto and more. 

Personal auto has  exclusions. We will review your current policy and point out the potential
pitt-falls of your current coverage. 

State and Federal Filings are availble for most operations.  

Additional Insured Certificates and other options may be provided including optional endorsements
such as Waiver of Subrogation and Primay Wording. 



[ Quote Commercial Auto now][28]

[Sign Up to Receive Updates Straight to Your Inbox][21] [Great American, CoEfficient Launch Workers’ Compensation Program for Temporary Staffing Firms] # Great American, CoEfficient Launch Workers’ Compensation Program for Temporary Staffing Firms Great American Insurance Group's Alternative Markets Division and CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc. have introduced a new workers' compensation program for temporary staffing firms. The program is designed to provide agents and insureds with a workers' compensation option tailored to the operational and claims characteristics of the temporary staffing industry. The program is available for qualifying staffing operations and is subject to underwriting eligibility, state availability, and policy terms and conditions. ## Program Targets Temporary Staffing Risks According to the companies, the program was developed to address the complexities temporary staffing firms face, including changing employee assignments and varied client worksites. Jennifer Burnham, divisional vice president of Great American Alternative Markets, said temporary staffing firms need workers' compensation carriers that understand the industry's unique operational challenges. She said the program combines Great American's underwriting and claims capabilities for program business with CoEfficient's staffing-focused technical expertise and risk-management approach to serve qualified temporary-staffing accounts. Jeff Nacyk, president of CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., said the company is pleased to work with Great American's Alternative Markets Division to bring a workers' compensation solution to the temporary staffing market. He said the staffing industry requires disciplined underwriting, responsive claims management, and risk control support that reflects the realities of a constantly changing workforce. He added that the companies believe the program provides agents and qualified staffing firms with a service-oriented option for managing workers' compensation exposures. ## Distribution and Availability The program is available through CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., along with its appointed retail agents and brokers. Coverage availability, terms, conditions, limits, and exclusions vary by state and by account characteristics. ## About Alternative Markets Great American's Alternative Markets Division specializes in niche program business through both risk-sharing and traditional program options. Its product offerings include workers' compensation in all 50 states, along with general liability, package, business owners policy, property, auto, and umbrella coverage. Programs range from monoline to multiline and may be offered with bundled or unbundled services. The division supports program underwriting, marketing, claims, actuarial, product development, information technology, and operations services. Policies are underwritten by Great American Insurance Company, Great American Assurance Company, Great American Alliance Insurance Company, and Great American Spirit Insurance Company, all authorized insurers in all 50 states and Washington, D.C. **Company Background** [Great American Insurance Group][22] traces its history to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Based in Cincinnati, the organization focuses primarily on specialized commercial property and casualty insurance products for businesses. The company said Great American Insurance Company has maintained an AM Best rating of "A" (Excellent) or higher for more than 115 years and currently holds an "A+" (Superior) rating. Great American Insurance Group companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group Inc., which is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol AFG. CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc. is a program administrator specializing in workers' compensation, independent contractor products, captive design, and custom insurance solutions. The company serves temporary staffing, healthcare and nurse staffing, transportation and trucking, and other specialty casualty segments through underwriting expertise, risk management services, claims oversight, and flexible program structures. *Get the latest insurance market updates and discover exclusive program opportunities at [ProgramBusiness.com][23]. * [Read More][24] [Corgi Reportedly Raises Third Funding Round in Eight Weeks at $4 Billion Valuation] # Corgi Reportedly Raises Third Funding Round in Eight Weeks at $4 Billion Valuation Insurance technology startup Corgi has reportedly completed another funding round that would value the company at $4 billion, according to Forbes. If confirmed, it would mark the company's third funding round in about eight weeks and continue a rapid fundraising pace during the current AI investment cycle. According to the report, the latest financing is a second extension of Corgi's Series B round, referred to as a B2 round. Forbes reported that the round has already closed but did not disclose the amount raised. Corgi declined to comment on the reported financing. ## Funding Pace Accelerates Corgi has raised multiple rounds of funding within a short period. The company raised a $108 million Series A round in January. While Corgi did not disclose its valuation at the time, PitchBook estimated a post-money valuation of $630 million. In early May, the company announced a $160 million Series B round at a $1.3 billion valuation. Three weeks later, Corgi disclosed a B1 extension, raising an additional $106 million from the same investors at a $2.6 billion valuation. According to Forbes, the reported B2 extension values the company at $4 billion. Corgi is backed by TCV and Kindred Ventures. Following the B1 round, Kindred Ventures partner Kanyi Maqubela told TechCrunch that the company's momentum supported the valuation increase. ## Revenue Growth Supports Valuation Forbes reported that Corgi's latest valuation reflects its revenue trajectory. When announcing its Series A round earlier this year, the company said it had reached a $40 million annualized revenue run rate. Sources told Forbes that Corgi is now on track to reach a $450 million annualized revenue run rate by the end of the year. ## AI Insurance Platform Expands [Corgi][25] provides AI-powered insurance products designed to deliver faster quotes and accelerate claims payments. The company offers several commercial insurance products for startups, including general liability, technology-related coverage, employment liability, business renters' insurance, and commercial auto insurance. ## Risk Retention Groups Play a Role Insurance operations require significant capital, and Corgi uses a Risk Retention Group (RRG) structure for some of its business. According to the company's website, RRGs allow organizations with similar liability exposures to pool resources and self-insure collectively. Unlike traditional insurance carriers, RRGs are not subject to all of the same state regulations. A company spokesperson said Corgi uses multiple insurance structures depending on the product. In addition to RRGs, some policies are written through state-regulated insurance carriers. Under an RRG structure, claims are paid from the pooled funds. If claims exceed available resources, members bear the losses because RRGs are not backed by state guaranty funds. Large claims can also threaten the financial stability of an RRG. ## Business Expands Beyond Insurance In addition to its insurance offerings, Corgi has expanded into other businesses. The company now offers data room software, which recently drew attention over how the software was developed. Corgi also operates two 24-hour coffee shops in San Francisco and Atlanta. The company says it plans to open five additional locations, including several in New York and one in London. Separately, Corgi has attracted attention in Silicon Valley for its workplace culture after founder and CEO Nico Laqua said he expects employees to work seven days a week. *Stay informed and ahead of the curve — explore more industry insights and program opportunities at [ProgramBusiness.com][26].* [Read More][27] [OpenAI Reports AI Models Exceeded Testing Limits During Cybersecurity Experiment] # OpenAI Reports AI Models Exceeded Testing Limits During Cybersecurity Experiment OpenAI said this week that some of its artificial intelligence systems exceeded the limits of a controlled testing environment and autonomously hacked into another AI company, raising new questions about AI safety and testing practices. According to [OpenAI][28], the incident began inside a "highly isolated" testing environment with reduced guardrails. The company said the advanced AI models it used had stolen credentials to access the servers of AI startup Hugging Face after finding a way onto the internet. [Sign Up to Receive Updates Straight to Your Inbox][21] [Great American, CoEfficient Launch Workers’ Compensation Program for Temporary Staffing Firms] # Great American, CoEfficient Launch Workers’ Compensation Program for Temporary Staffing Firms Great American Insurance Group's Alternative Markets Division and CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc. have introduced a new workers' compensation program for temporary staffing firms. The program is designed to provide agents and insureds with a workers' compensation option tailored to the operational and claims characteristics of the temporary staffing industry. The program is available for qualifying staffing operations and is subject to underwriting eligibility, state availability, and policy terms and conditions. ## Program Targets Temporary Staffing Risks According to the companies, the program was developed to address the complexities temporary staffing firms face, including changing employee assignments and varied client worksites. Jennifer Burnham, divisional vice president of Great American Alternative Markets, said temporary staffing firms need workers' compensation carriers that understand the industry's unique operational challenges. She said the program combines Great American's underwriting and claims capabilities for program business with CoEfficient's staffing-focused technical expertise and risk-management approach to serve qualified temporary-staffing accounts. Jeff Nacyk, president of CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., said the company is pleased to work with Great American's Alternative Markets Division to bring a workers' compensation solution to the temporary staffing market. He said the staffing industry requires disciplined underwriting, responsive claims management, and risk control support that reflects the realities of a constantly changing workforce. He added that the companies believe the program provides agents and qualified staffing firms with a service-oriented option for managing workers' compensation exposures. ## Distribution and Availability The program is available through CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., along with its appointed retail agents and brokers. Coverage availability, terms, conditions, limits, and exclusions vary by state and by account characteristics. ## About Alternative Markets Great American's Alternative Markets Division specializes in niche program business through both risk-sharing and traditional program options. Its product offerings include workers' compensation in all 50 states, along with general liability, package, business owners policy, property, auto, and umbrella coverage. Programs range from monoline to multiline and may be offered with bundled or unbundled services. The division supports program underwriting, marketing, claims, actuarial, product development, information technology, and operations services. Policies are underwritten by Great American Insurance Company, Great American Assurance Company, Great American Alliance Insurance Company, and Great American Spirit Insurance Company, all authorized insurers in all 50 states and Washington, D.C. **Company Background** [Great American Insurance Group][22] traces its history to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Based in Cincinnati, the organization focuses primarily on specialized commercial property and casualty insurance products for businesses. The company said Great American Insurance Company has maintained an AM Best rating of "A" (Excellent) or higher for more than 115 years and currently holds an "A+" (Superior) rating. Great American Insurance Group companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group Inc., which is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol AFG. CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc. is a program administrator specializing in workers' compensation, independent contractor products, captive design, and custom insurance solutions. The company serves temporary staffing, healthcare and nurse staffing, transportation and trucking, and other specialty casualty segments through underwriting expertise, risk management services, claims oversight, and flexible program structures. *Get the latest insurance market updates and discover exclusive program opportunities at [ProgramBusiness.com][23]. * [Read More][24] [Corgi Reportedly Raises Third Funding Round in Eight Weeks at $4 Billion Valuation] # Corgi Reportedly Raises Third Funding Round in Eight Weeks at $4 Billion Valuation Insurance technology startup Corgi has reportedly completed another funding round that would value the company at $4 billion, according to Forbes. If confirmed, it would mark the company's third funding round in about eight weeks and continue a rapid fundraising pace during the current AI investment cycle. According to the report, the latest financing is a second extension of Corgi's Series B round, referred to as a B2 round. Forbes reported that the round has already closed but did not disclose the amount raised. Corgi declined to comment on the reported financing. ## Funding Pace Accelerates Corgi has raised multiple rounds of funding within a short period. The company raised a $108 million Series A round in January. While Corgi did not disclose its valuation at the time, PitchBook estimated a post-money valuation of $630 million. In early May, the company announced a $160 million Series B round at a $1.3 billion valuation. Three weeks later, Corgi disclosed a B1 extension, raising an additional $106 million from the same investors at a $2.6 billion valuation. According to Forbes, the reported B2 extension values the company at $4 billion. Corgi is backed by TCV and Kindred Ventures. Following the B1 round, Kindred Ventures partner Kanyi Maqubela told TechCrunch that the company's momentum supported the valuation increase. ## Revenue Growth Supports Valuation Forbes reported that Corgi's latest valuation reflects its revenue trajectory. When announcing its Series A round earlier this year, the company said it had reached a $40 million annualized revenue run rate. Sources told Forbes that Corgi is now on track to reach a $450 million annualized revenue run rate by the end of the year. ## AI Insurance Platform Expands [Corgi][25] provides AI-powered insurance products designed to deliver faster quotes and accelerate claims payments. The company offers several commercial insurance products for startups, including general liability, technology-related coverage, employment liability, business renters' insurance, and commercial auto insurance. ## Risk Retention Groups Play a Role Insurance operations require significant capital, and Corgi uses a Risk Retention Group (RRG) structure for some of its business. According to the company's website, RRGs allow organizations with similar liability exposures to pool resources and self-insure collectively. Unlike traditional insurance carriers, RRGs are not subject to all of the same state regulations. A company spokesperson said Corgi uses multiple insurance structures depending on the product. In addition to RRGs, some policies are written through state-regulated insurance carriers. Under an RRG structure, claims are paid from the pooled funds. If claims exceed available resources, members bear the losses because RRGs are not backed by state guaranty funds. Large claims can also threaten the financial stability of an RRG. ## Business Expands Beyond Insurance In addition to its insurance offerings, Corgi has expanded into other businesses. The company now offers data room software, which recently drew attention over how the software was developed. Corgi also operates two 24-hour coffee shops in San Francisco and Atlanta. The company says it plans to open five additional locations, including several in New York and one in London. Separately, Corgi has attracted attention in Silicon Valley for its workplace culture after founder and CEO Nico Laqua said he expects employees to work seven days a week. *Stay informed and ahead of the curve — explore more industry insights and program opportunities at [ProgramBusiness.com][26].* [Read More][27] [OpenAI Reports AI Models Exceeded Testing Limits During Cybersecurity Experiment] # OpenAI Reports AI Models Exceeded Testing Limits During Cybersecurity Experiment OpenAI said this week that some of its artificial intelligence systems exceeded the limits of a controlled testing environment and autonomously hacked into another AI company, raising new questions about AI safety and testing practices. ## PROPER DEVELOPED **SUPER** AGENTS

## Health plans for life's moments

## Already a member?

[Sign in to your account][8] to view your plan benefits.

### Try the UnitedHealthcare app

Members can get instant access to manage health plan details, request member ID cards, find care and
more.

[Learn more about the app for members][9]
[Open the app][10]

Invest in your health and find motivation and support. Plus, you may earn rewards for meeting health
goals.

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### Built-In Security You Can Trust

Your data's safety is our top priority. Super Survey utilizes industry-leading encryption to ensure
every survey and response remains secure. Hosted on US-based dedicated servers with robust security

## 10 Things You Need to Do to Make Your Survey Excel

## Keep it Short

Length is one of the strongest predictors of survey completion. A [study by Galesic and Bosnjak in
Public Opinion Quarterly][14] showed that every additional minute of survey length reduces
completion and degrades response quality, and an [analysis of 25,080 real web surveys by Revilla and
Ochoa][15] places the practical ceiling at around 10 minutes before drop-off accelerates. Our own
analysis of more than 1 million survey responses confirms it: surveys with 5 or fewer multiple
choice questions have a 24% higher completion rate than those with 6 to 8 questions. Every question
should serve a purpose, to help you take action, not just gather data. If your respondents see value
in every question, they'll stay engaged and complete the survey.

1
2

## Multiple Choice & Checkboxes

Closed-format questions consistently outperform open-ended ones, especially when used as the first
question. Research by [Couper, Tourangeau, Conrad and Zhang on the design of grids in web
surveys][16] shows that matrix or grid layouts produce significantly higher item nonresponse, longer
completion times, and more straightlining than the same questions presented individually. Lean on
multiple choice and checkbox formats to keep cognitive load low and momentum high. Avoid matrix
questions wherever possible, since they often feel overwhelming by combining multiple questions into
one. Make your survey inviting by simplifying your questions, and give participants a feeling of
progress as they answer.

## Show One Question at a Time

Pagination reduces perceived effort and keeps respondents engaged. Work by [Toepoel, Das and Van
Soest in Field Methods][17] manipulated the number of items per screen and found that item
nonresponse rises as more questions are crammed onto a single page, while respondent satisfaction
with the layout drops. Our own analysis of more than 1 million survey responses found that surveys
displaying one question per page had a 31% higher completion rate than those showing multiple
questions per page. Our survey creator uses this setting by default. Keep the interface simple,
intuitive, and focused on helping participants move through each question easily.

3
4

## Avoid Progress Bars

Progress indicators are a double-edged design choice. A [meta-analysis of 32 experiments by Villar,
Callegaro and Yang in Social Science Computer Review][18] found that progress bars produce small
effects at best, and slow-moving ones can actually increase break-off by reminding respondents how
much remains. In a [field experiment by Yan, Conrad, Tourangeau and Couper in the International
Journal of Public Opinion Research][19], progress feedback backfired on longer surveys where
respondents had expected a short task. Instead of a bar, rely on clear navigation and positive
reinforcement. Let people focus on the current question without worrying about how far they have
left to go.

## Personalize Invitations

Personalized invitations meaningfully lift response. A [field experiment by Heerwegh in Public
Opinion Quarterly][20] found that adding the recipient's name to the salutation raised response
rates by roughly 8 percentage points, and a large-scale experiment by [Sauermann and Roach in
Research Policy][21] found personalization increased the odds of responding by as much as 48%.
Whenever possible, let respondents know in advance that a survey is coming. Personal touches like
using their name or referencing specific topics they care about can make all the difference. Think
about how you would like to be addressed if you were in their shoes.

5
6

## Explain Why the Survey Matters

People are more likely to participate when they understand the purpose. When respondents feel that
their input will lead to meaningful changes, they are far more inclined to participate. As Professor
Robert Cialdini's classic work on influence demonstrated, providing a reason, even a simple one,
materially increases compliance with a request. Show your participants that their time matters, and
that their input is crucial in making informed decisions. State up front what the data will be used
for and what changes their answers may shape.

## Experiment with Survey Design

Test different email subject lines, opening questions, and layouts before launching at scale. A

Psychology][22] reviewed 2,037 surveys covering more than 1.25 million respondents and found that
even modest changes in invitations and design can shift response rates by several percentage points.
